name: Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints
summary: In Windshear Crag, goblin rivals covet the Venture Company’s Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints. They show how to build the mechanized woodcutter deployed in Stonetalon Mountains, under gnome engineer Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle’s supervision.

sections.title: Industrial Espionage in Windshear Crag
sections.body: Venture Company operators carry the Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints through Windshear Crag. The plans show how to build the great mechanized lumber harvesters behind the company’s clear-cutting. Goblin engineers resent that Gerenzo, a gnome, was put in charge of the design. After the company ousted goblin engineer Ziz Fizziks, Sputtervalve hired him to steal the plans. Yet Gerenzo’s dense, eccentric notes are nearly as hard to decipher as the blueprints are to seize by force.

faq.answer: The Super Reaper 6000 is an enormous mechanized woodcutter built for the Venture Company’s clear-cutting in Stonetalon Mountains.

Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, a gnome engineer, designed the plans under the Venture Company’s supervision after being hired to lead its mechanical work in Windshear Crag. His appointment angered local goblin mechanics.

faq.q: Why does Ziz Fizziks want these blueprints?
faq.answer: After the Venture Company ousted Ziz Fizziks, Sputtervalve hired him to steal the plans. Ziz wants to prove his worth and mechanical genius to his new boss.

faq.q: Who holds the blueprints in Windshear Crag?
faq.answer: Venture Co. operators carry the physical schematics and oversee machinery and timber clearing throughout Windshear Crag.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can see how Gerenzo’s precise gnomish schematics leave ordinary tinkerers baffled, even as goblin corporate muscle puts the machinery to work.
As a gnome, you can see Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle’s ingenuity in the blueprints. Even the Venture Company relies on a gnome engineer to design its complex heavy machinery.
